title: Naturally Sweet Brazilian Coconut Cookies
description: These sweet and flaky cookies are a classic Brazilian dessert featuring icing sugar and dashi extract, made with macrobiotic friendly ingredients and perfect for serving in a bento box.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, icing sugar, and salt.
Add the melted coconut oil, dashi extract, egg replacer, and vanilla extract to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Scoop the dough into small balls and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Flatten the balls slightly with a fork.
Bake for 15 minutes or until lightly golden.
Allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.
Serve the cookies in a bento box and enjoy.
